results.title: Undergraduate Prospectus (Fall 2026)
results.text: Undergraduate Prospectus Fall 2026 www.uet.edu.pk 238 UG FEE REGULATIONS 1. Periods of fees and Other Charges a) The fees and other charges are categorized as: i. One-time payments at the time of admission ii. Semester recurring fees iii. Summer semester dues for students registering during summer semester b) During each year of a student’s stay at the University, all recurring fees are charged in two installments payable at the beginning of Fall and Spring semesters except for the first semester wherein students can pay the charges in two installments. c) Registration fee at the rate of: (i) Rs 2,634/- per credit hour for subsidized category, and (ii) Rs 9,835/- per credit hour for partially subsidized category will be charged for subjects registered during the summer semester. d) A total of 8 semesters or 10 semesters recurring fees are admissible from students graduating from a four years degree program or a five years degree program, respectively. e) Students registering in subjects after completing 8 semesters or 10 semesters, respectively, from a four years degree program or a five years degree program

results.text: This process will continue for a maximum of three weeks after the commencement of classes or until all seats are filled. Application Submission Process: Interested candidates will have to submit an online application through the admission portal according to the announced schedule and generate a challan fee according to their status. Fee Structure: Existing candidates will pay Rs. 1500 while new candidates will pay Rs. 3000. The fee must be deposited in the designated bank. Validity of Application: After fee submission, the application will remain valid for one week. Merit List Announcement: Every Friday night, a list of selected candidates will be displayed on the admission portal. Selected candidates must submit the fee and report to the university within the prescribed time so that all admission formalities can be completed. Reapplication Process: If a candidate is not selected within one week, the application will expire, and the candidate will have to apply again and submit the fee for the following week. This process will continue on a weekly basis for a maximum of three weeks, provided seats are available.
